place: 北京三環至四環各路口（六里橋、公主墳、呼家樓等）

title.zh: 工人糾察與市民在路口向受阻車隊士兵送水、饅頭並交談
title.en: Workers and residents bring water, steamed buns, and newspapers to stalled convoy soldiers (19–22 May)

summary.zh: 5 月 19 日夜至 22 日間，大量工人、公交司機與街坊市民在公主墳、六里橋、呼家樓等路口攔停進城軍車後，許多人自發提著熱水瓶、饅頭、汽水與當日報紙走近車廂，向連日受困、多為外地調來的年輕士兵說明北京城內和平靜坐的情況。此類平和對話與送水相勸的場面在多份目擊證言、使館紀錄與新聞影像中均有記載；遊戲中的具體人物與對話為虛構合寫。
summary.en: Between the night of 19 May and 22 May, after factory workers, bus drivers, and local residents halted advancing military convoys at intersections such as Gongzhufen, Liuliqiao, and Hujialou, many brought thermoses of water, steamed buns, soft drinks, and daily newspapers to the stalled trucks and talked with young out-of-province soldiers about the peaceful sit-in inside the city. Eyewitness testimonies, diplomatic cables, and news footage document these exchanges; specific characters and lines in the game are fictional composites.
